description: In 2020, nanotron was acquired by Inpixon. Together, nanotron’s solutions and Inpixon’s indoor data technology, sensors, video surveillance solutions, and GPS offerings, combine to deliver actionable indoor location data and intelligence. Nanotron is a leading provider of electronic location awareness solutions. If knowing what, where and when is mission-critical to your business, rely on nanotron with Location Running.
